look: a small female goblin with moss-green skin, a big bald warty head, very large pointed ears, a long pointed tan-brown nose and a slight wiry body with thin sinewy arms
skin_words: muted moss-green hue, its dry chalky surface
line_words: thin, crisp, dark green contour line
arms_paint: narrow slim shoulders across the shoulder band; level thin sinewy arms with a slight elbow and a slender forearm, in the same dry matte mid-tone skin with soft-edged low-contrast modelling
hands_paint: each hand with five long thin fingers, soft matte knuckles and short fingernails
face_paint: the head as a big bald scalp of dry, chalky, matte moss-green skin in one even mid-tone, modelled with soft low-contrast brushwork and speckled with the same small darker green warts the sculpt shows, with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural goblin woman's face strongly foreshortened from above, a sly scowling brow over shadowed eye slits, a long pointed nose in dull tan-brown exactly where the sculpt's nose is tan, and a narrow jaw with its two tiny fangs; each big ear a broad leaf of green skin with a wide dull pink-brown inner hollow exactly where the sculpt is pink-brown
torso_paint: the torso as one narrow slight chest with a soft flat breastbone and a small round belly below it
notes: painter: female = slimmer wording, moss-green sampled from legacy scalp. Corrective pass: tan nose, pink-brown ear hollows and scalp warts are carried by guide features (colours nose / earhollow / wart); ears raised to about 40 degrees with a broader blade; gen runs use a --text-file whose swatch sentence asks for soft matte close mid-tones (the shared sentence asks for a highlight on the scalp, which gave gloss)
dome: bald scalp dotted with small darker green warts
finish: dry chalky matte skin with a soft diffuse painterly surface
